messages:
isabel: FYI starting a follow-up thread to package evidence from the recent entitlement sweep. Compliance wants an attestation bundle with pre/post states + KMS grant provenance.
tomo: what format do they want? last time they wanted csv + signed manifest.
isabel: correct. We'll produce: attestation.csv (principal,role,pre_state_link,post_state_link,action,author,change_id), manifest.json.sig (detached sig of manifest), and full tfstate snapshots.
kay: where do we store the bundle? s3 cold storage?
audit-bot: [audit] pre-snapshot uploaded s3://redwood-audit/evidence/4209876543/pre-snapshot.csv by isabel at 2026-03-21T18:02:33Z
isabel: store in s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/entitlement-sweeps/4209876543/ with 7y retention and bucket-level-locked policy. Only compliance and sec-admins have access.
tomo: KMS provenance: need to include grant history for each key touched (grantor, grantee, timestamp, request-id). We can pull from key-audit logs and include a key_provenance.csv. Kay can you run the join?
kay: yes. I'll join logs by request-id and include the IAM diff. Expect ~150 rows.
compliance-bot: [req] SEC-EVIDENCE-4209876543 expected by 2026-03-28T23:59Z. Please attach attestation.csv and manifest.sig.
isabel: also include a short writeup: sweep-summary.md (one-paragraph) noting scope, exclusions (HSM keys, cert-rotation principals), and rollback metrics.
tomo: small note on auto-revokes: any auto-revoke must have a regrant-path id and a TTL. For audit we include regrant_token column in attestation.csv. If a team requests regrant, they reference that token.
isabel: good. We'll record: regrant_token for auto-revokes, and revert_pr for manual revokes.
kay: how about cryptographic signing? who signs the manifest?
isabel: sec-lead signs with team KMS key; we produce a detached signature (RFC 5652 style) and store the public key in the compliance keyring.
compliance-bot: [policy] evidence format validated: attestation.csv headers must be exactly: principal,role,pre_state_link,post_state_link,action,author,change_id,regrant_token,notes.
audit-bot: [snapshot] post-snapshot uploaded s3://redwood-audit/evidence/4209876543/post-snapshot.csv by tomo at 2026-03-21T18:06:10Z
tomo: important: HSM-backed keys are excluded from automated revokes. We must include an HSM_exemption.csv listing key ids and rationale signed-off by PKI.
isabel: yes PKI owner signed exemptions are required. attach PKI ticket links.
kay: I'll assemble key_provenance.csv and HSM_exemption.csv, then run the manifest generator script: `./tools/evidence/mktar.sh --input-dir ./evidence/4209876543 --out evidence-4209876543.tgz`
isabel: include checksums (sha256) of all files in manifest before signing.
compliance-bot: [ack] evidence bundle checklist received. Missing: manifest.sig and sweep-summary.md. Deadline still 2026-03-28.
isabel: timeline: assemble files by EOD tomorrow, sign and upload the day after, then validation run with compliance. Also we'll create SEC-5005 to track packaging.
audit-bot: [jira] SEC-5005 evidence packaging ticket created by isabel.
tomo: last ops detail: for terraform state we snapshot before change and after change. store names: s3://redwood-state/evidence/4209876543-pre.tfstate and -post.tfstate. Also include the commit hash and PR link in attestation.csv.
kay: done. I'll upload interim csvs to the ticket for review.
isabel: final: add a 24h watch after bundle upload where any anomalous Grant/Revoke on prod KMS keys will auto-notify compliance and sec-oncall.
compliance-bot: [alert] watch rule enabled for evidence bundle 4209876543.
isabel: thanks team. once compliance validates, we'll publish a one-paragraph summary to #general and close SEC-5005. :white_check_mark:
